notes.title: New color palettes
notes.content:
Added 2 new color palettes for free jam projects made after the game.

T: (M, E, A): an apolitical coordinate-determined turn-based rpg about decolonising the Sakha Republic with shamanism and abstract violence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534925/864f94fe4e71cf007bb3b55b5d6012b2d739ba92.png

DESTROZALTRI: an apolitical bullet hell boss rush about destroying the Altri  company and burning down their pulp factory project in Galicia, with links to a real protest movement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534925/4da6ff6523128653a7cf2007a77d6b5f3d8fa1ab.png

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused the player to move left if they tried backing into a wall during the final level.

notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content:
Added D-Pad support for movement controls.
(Hopefully) Fixed the palette menu not unlocking earlier games.
Changed the trigger warning text to make clear that the game mentions generative AI, but does not use it.
